2608.24574.title: PhysMLLMs: Spatial Priors for Unified Referring Segmentation and Grounded Reasoning of Images and Videos
2608.24574.paper_summary: Video multimodal large language models support language guided video segmentation, but they often show spatio temporal inconsistencies, e.g., jitter, drift, and identity switches. These failures are more common when targets are partly hidden or when similar objects appear nearby.One likely reason is that current training lacks explicit spatial priors, which makes it difficult to maintain stable spatial identity and shape over time. We present PhysMLLMs, a training-stage prior injection architecture that injects physics-inspired spatial continuity priors into Video MLLMs. PhysMLLMs is designed to encourage more stable object-centered representations by aligning the student global visual representation with a frozen teacher model during training. Our core mechanism, Global Representation Prior Alignment (REPA-Global), distills global visual representations from a frozen DINOv2 teacher using an offline embedding cache and a scheduled distillation plan. This design keeps inference unchanged and does not add inference time cost. Across multiple video benchmarks, PhysMLLMs improves video segmentation mask quality and cross-frame consistency, with larger gains on challenging cases involving small targets, fast motion, occlusion, distractors, and reasoning queries. On single-frame referring image segmentation and representative general VLM benchmarks, PhysMLLMs maintains comparable performance, demonstrating that the injected spatial prior improves video consistency without compromising image-level grounding or general multimodal capability. These results suggest that physics-inspired spatial prior injection can improve temporal stability while preserving general capability. The code is available at https://github.com/tusu-code/20260121-icml2026-2.git.
2608.24574.paper_summary_zh: 視頻多模態大型語言模型支持語言引導的視頻分割，但它們經常顯示出時空不一致性，例如抖動、漂移和身份切換。當目標部分被遮擋或相似物體出現在附近時，這些失敗更為常見。一個可能的原因是目前的訓練缺乏明確的空間先驗，這使得在時間上保持穩定的空間身份和形狀變得困難。我們提出了PhysMLLMs，一種訓練階段的先驗注入架構，將受物理啟發的空間連續性先驗注入到視頻MLLM中。PhysMLLMs旨在通過在訓練期間將學生的全局視覺表示與凍結的教師模型對齊，來鼓勵更穩定的以物體為中心的表示。我們的核心機制，全局表示先驗對齊（REPA-Global），使用離線嵌入緩存和計劃的蒸餾計劃，從凍結的DINOv2教師中提取全局視覺表示。這一設計保持推理不變，並且不增加推理時間成本。在多個視頻基準測試中，PhysMLLMs改善了視頻分割掩碼質量和跨幀一致性，對於涉及小目標、快速運動、遮擋、干擾物和推理查詢的挑戰性案例有更大的增益。在單幀參考圖像分割和代表性的通用VLM基準測試中，PhysMLLMs保持了可比的性能，證明注入的空間先驗提高了視頻一致性，而不妨礙圖像級的基礎或通用多模態能力。這些結果表明，受物理啟發的空間先驗注入可以提高時間穩定性，同時保持一般能力。代碼可在 https://github.com/tusu-code/20260121-icml2026-2.git 獲得。
